items.text: Amadodana kaLevi; uGereshoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Amadodana kaKohati: ngoShela; u-Amramu, noJisihari, noHebroni, no-Uziyeli.
Abantwana bakwa-Amramu; u-Aroni noMose noMiriyamu. Futhi amadodana ka-Aroni; oNadabi, no-Abihu, no-Eleyazare, no-Itamari.
U-Eleyazare wazala uFinehasi, uFinehasi wazala u-Abishuwa,
U-Abishuwa wazala uBhuki, noBhuki ka-Uzi;
U-Uzi wazala uSeragiya, noSeragiya kaMerayoti,
uMerayoti wazala u-Amariya, no-Amariya wazala u-Ahithubi,
U-Ahithubi wazala uSadoki, noSadoki wazala u-Ahimahazi;
U-Ahimahazi wazala u-Azariya no-Azariya kuJohanani,
UJohanani wayenguyise ka-Azariya (nguye owayengobupristi ethempelini elakhiwa nguSolomoni eJerusalema).
U-Azariya wazala u-Amariya, no-Amariya ka-Ahithubi,
U-Ahithubi wazala uSadoki, noSadoki kaShalumi;
UShalumi wazala uHilikiya, noHilikiya wazala u-Azariya,
U-Azariya wazala uSeraya, noSeraya kuJosadaki,
UJehoshadaki wathuthela ekuthunjweni lapho uJehova esusa uJuda neJerusalema ngesandla sikaNebukadinesari.
Amadodana kaLevi; uGereshomu, noKohati, noMerari.
Lawa angamagama amadodana kaGereshomu: ngo: uLibni noShimeyi.
Amadodana kaKohati: ngo-Amramu, noJisihari, noHebroni, no-Uziyeli.
Amadodana kaMerari; UMahli noMusi. Lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaLevi ngokoyise.
UVan Gersom; indodana yakhe uLibini, indodana yakhe uJahati, indodana yakhe uSima,
uJowaki indodana yakhe, u-Ido indodana yakhe, uSeraki indodana yakhe, uJeyarayi indodana yakhe.
Amadodana kaKohati: indodana yakhe u-Aminadaba, indodana yakhe uKora, indodana yakhe u-Asiri,
indodana yakhe u-Elkana, no-Ebhiyasafa indodana yakhe, no-Asiri indodana yakhe,
uThahati indodana yakhe, u-Uriyeli indodana yakhe, u-Uziya indodana yakhe, uSawule indodana yakhe.
Amadodana ka-Elkana ngu u-Amasayi no-Ahimoti.
Ngokuqondene no-Elkana: amadodana ka-Elkana; Indodana yakhe uSofa kanye nendodana yakhe uNahati,
no-Eliyabe indodana yakhe, noJerohamu indodana yakhe, no-Elkana indodana yakhe.
Amadodana kaSamuweli: izibulo uVashni no-Abiya.
Amadodana kaMerari; uMagili indodana yakhe, uLibini indodana yakhe, uShimeyi indodana yakhe, u-Uza indodana yakhe,
uSimeya indodana yakhe, uHagiya indodana yakhe, uAsaya indodana yakhe.
Laba yibo uDavide ababeka phezu kwenkonzo yokuhlabelela endlini kaJehova emva kokuphumula komphongolo.
Bakhonza ngokuhlabelela phambi kwendlu yetende lokuhlangana, uSolomoni waze wayakha indlu kaJehova eJerusalema;
Futhi yibo abalinda nabantwana babo. Kumadodana amaKohati: nguHemani umculi, indodana kaJoweli, indodana kaSamuweli,
indodana ka-Elkana, indodana kaJerohamu, indodana ka-Eliyeli, indodana kaThowagi,
indodana kaSufi, indodana ka-Elkana, indodana kaMahati, indodana ka-Amasayi,
indodana ka-Elkana, indodana kaJoweli, indodana ka-Azariya, indodana kaZefaniya,
indodana kaThahati, indodana ka-Asiri, indodana ka-Ebiyasafa, indodana kaKhora,
indodana kaJisihari, indodana kaKohati, indodana kaLevi, indodana ka-Israyeli.
Umfowabo u-Asafa owayemi ngakwesokunene sakhe kwakungu-Asafa indodana kaBerakiya indodana kaShimeya,
indodana kaMikayeli, indodana kaBahaseya, indodana kaMalikiya,
indodana ka-Etheni, indodana kaSeraki, indodana ka-Adaya,
indodana ka-Ethani, indodana kaShima, indodana kaShimeyi,
indodana kaJahati, indodana kaGereshomu, indodana kaLevi.
Abafowabo, amadodana kaMerari, babemi ngakwesokhohlo: u-Ethani indodana kaKishi indodana ka-Abidi indodana kaMaluki,
indodana kaHashabiya, indodana ka-Amasiya, indodana kaHilikiya,
indodana ka-Amsi, indodana kaBani, indodana kaShameri,
indodana kaMageli, indodana kaMusi, indodana kaMerari, indodana kaLevi.
Nabafowabo, amaLevi, babemiselwe yonke imisebenzi yenkonzo yetabernakele lendlu kaNkulunkulu.

Kepha u-Aroni namadodana akhe banikela e-altare lomnikelo wokushiswa nase-altare lempepho, babemiselwe wonke umsebenzi wendawo engcwelengcwele, benzele u-Israyeli ukubuyisana, njengakho konke uMose, inceku kaNkulunkulu, akwenzileyo wayala.
Lawa angamadodana ka-Aroni; indodana yakhe u-Eleyazare, indodana yakhe uFinehasi, indodana yakhe u-Abishuwa,
uBuki indodana yakhe, u-Uzi indodana yakhe, uSeragiya indodana yakhe,
indodana yakhe uMerayothi, indodana yakhe u-Amariya, indodana yakhe u-Ahithubi,
uZadoki indodana yakhe, u-Ahimahazi indodana yakhe.
Lezi zaziyizindawo zabo zokuhlala ezinqabeni zabo emkhawulweni wabo, emadodaneni ka-Aroni emindenini yamaKohati; ngokuba inkatho yadla kubo.
Babanika iHebroni ezweni lakwaJuda nedlelo layo nxazonke zalo.
Kodwa insimu yomuzi nemizana yawo bakunika uKalebi indodana kaJefune.
Amadodana ka-Aroni abanika imizi yakwaJuda: iHebroni, idolobha elikhululekile, neLibina namadlelo alo, neJatiri, ne-Estemowa namadlelo alo,
noHilen nedlelo lakhe, neDebiri nedlelo lakhe,
ne-Asan nedlelo layo, neBeti Shemeshi nedlelo layo;
Esizweni sakwaBenjamini; iGeba nedlelo layo, neAlemeti nedlelo layo, neAnathoti nedlelo layo. Yonke imizi yabo ngemindeni yabo yayiyimizi eyishumi nantathu.
Abantwana bakwaKohati abasala ohlwini lozalo lwaleso sizwe banikwa imizi eyishumi engxenyeni yesizwe sakwaManase ngenkatho imizi eyishumi.
Oonyana bakaGereshomu ngemindeni yabo banikwa imizi eyishumi nantathu esizweni sakwa-Isakare, nasesizweni sakwa-Asheri, nasesizweni sakwaNafetali, nasesizweni sakwaManase eBashani.
Oonyana bakaMerari ngenkatho ngokwemizalwane yabo, esizweni sakwaRubeni, nasesizweni sakwaGadi, nasesizweni sakwaZebuloni, imizi eyishumi nambili.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli banika amaLevi le mizi namadlelo ayo.
Babanika ngenkatho leyo mizi ebizwa ngegama layo esizweni sabantwana bakwaJuda, nasesizweni sabantwana bakwaSimeyoni, nasesizweni sabantwana bakwaBenjamini.
Abaseleyo emindenini yamadodana kaKohati babenemizi yomkhawulo wabo esizweni sakwa-Efrayimi.
Babanika emizini ekhululekileyo, iShekemi ezintabeni zakwa-Efrayimi namadlelo alo; banika iGezeri nedlelo layo;
neJokimeyamu nedlelo layo, neBeti Horoni namadlelo ayo,
ne-Ajaloni nedlelo layo, neGatrimoni nedlelo layo;
Engxenyeni yesizwe sakwaManase; I-Aneri nedlelo lakhe, noBileyamu nedlelo lakhe, esizukulwaneni sensali yamadodana kaKohati.
Amadodana kaGereshomu aphiwa ozalweni lwengxenye yesizwe sakwaManase: iGolani eBashani namadlelo alo, ne-Ashitaroti namadlelo alo.
Esizweni sakwa-Isakare; iKedesi nedlelo layo, neDaberat nedlelo layo,
neRamoti nedlelo layo, ne-Anem nedlelo layo;
Esizweni sakwa-Asheri; iMasal nedlelo layo, ne-Abdoni nedlelo layo,
neHukoki nedlelo layo, neRehobe nedlelo layo;
Esizweni sakwaNafetali; iKedeshi yaseGalile nedlelo layo, neHamoni nedlelo layo, neKiriyatayimi nedlelo layo.
Abanye abantwana bakwaMerari banikwa esizweni sakwaZebuloni: iRimoni namadlelo alo, neThabhori namadlelo alo.
Ngaphesheya kweJordani ngaseJeriko ngasempumalanga kwaseJordani banikwa esizweni sakwaRubeni, iBezeri ehlane namadlelo alo, neJahasa namadlelo alo,
neKedemoti nedlelo layo, neMefahati nedlelo layo;
Esizweni sakwaGadi; iRamoti kwaGileyadi nedlelo layo, neMahanayimi nedlelo layo,
neHeshiboni nedlelo layo, neJazeri namadlelo alo.
